A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-tallonroll-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Tallon Roll]]: The game text is reworded: “Target two starfighters (your TIE/ln and any Rebel starfighter) present at same system or sector. Each player draws destiny. Opponent totals destiny and starship’s power. You total destiny, TIE’s power and TIE’s maneuver. Lowest total loses starfighter.” These are the same words as [[Tallon Roll (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
